subject.title: fix: plugins list JSON no longer reports empty harness ids

question: Should `openclaw plugins list --json` intentionally remove the previously present but unobserved `agentHarnessIds` property for existing script consumers?
rationale: The code and plugin-manifest contract establish that the empty value is misleading, but whether to make this public JSON-shape break rather than retain a compatibility representation is an owner decision.

options.title: Accept omission as the contract
options.body: Merge the patch and treat runtime-registration fields as absent from metadata-only list output unless they were actually observed.

options.title: Preserve a compatible representation
options.body: Keep an explicitly documented field or add a versioned/availability signal if existing JSON consumers require a stable property shape.

recommendation.title: Accept omission as the contract
recommendation.body: Merge the patch and treat runtime-registration fields as absent from metadata-only list output unless they were actually observed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent plugin-discovery work makes steipete the best available routing candidate for the metadata-versus-runtime contract.
